The rubric has {{< var n_criteria >}} criteria in three tiers, {{< var n_core >}} of them core. Each criterion has its own "profile page", which consists of its definition; when the criterion counts as **met**, **partially met** and **not met**; when the criterion is **not applicable** (N/A); its prerequisites; and the text evidence from the scoping review sources.

The site is generated from `{{< var rubric_file >}}`.
